settings.preferenceHint: Change anytime; this does not replace photo observations
settings.contentHint: Photo retention is still controlled per analysis
settings.keepByDefaultHint: New analyses default to automatic deletion after 3 days; you can change this per report.
settings.personalizedTutorialsHint: Adjust creator tutorial ranking using your skin type, market, and feedback.

overview.heroDescription: Start with your complexion, features, and makeup goals to get a natural, specific routine you can actually follow.
overview.lookDescription: Determined from your face shape, undertone, and skin condition after upload
report.description: Use visible features, color tendencies, and facial proportions to create the makeup direction and eight-step tutorial that fit you best.
report.previewTitle: Natural glow, keeping the real you.
report.photoNotSaved: Original photo is not saved in history
report.placeholderDisclosure: Directional placeholder, not a promise of a real try-on
report.recommendationFallback: Even base makeup, naturally elongated outer corners, and low-saturation warm lips may suit you. Avoid heavy nose contour and high-contrast sculpting.
report.retentionDescription: Local records keep photo metadata; photos are marked for immediate deletion by default and kept for up to 3 days when selected.
report.tutorialDisclosure: These are skin-matched search links; the full version will use curated tutorials with freshness checks.
library.title: Find the one that fits you.
library.description: Start from an existing shade to find close options from other brands and tutorials you can follow.
library.matchDescription: Matching currently uses undertone, skin type, category, and market rules; color difference calculations will be added with standardized values.
library.notice: Product matching supports decisions and is not exact; links are manually maintained and will gain freshness checks in the full version.
history.description: Every analysis leaves a plan you can revisit; photos are saved only when you choose.
history.retentionDescription: The local Server API stores analysis records and photo metadata only; unsaved photos are marked for immediate deletion and saved photos are kept for up to 3 days.
saved.description: Keep the products you genuinely want to try here.
saved.emptyDescription: Save products you want to try from an analysis report.
upload.title: Upload a front-facing photo
upload.description: Only human, single-person, front-facing photos are supported. Do not upload ID photos, group photos, or other sensitive images.
upload.policy: Local analysis does not automatically send photos to OpenAI; the original is sent only when a real GPT-image-2 preview is enabled. Originals are not saved by default and can be kept for 3 days.
